seoTitle: CPS Calendar 2025-2026: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the CPS 2025-2026 school calendar with official source dates, first day, last day, holidays, breaks, printable PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The CPS calendar from Chicago Public Schools lists 176 K-12 student attendance days for 2025-2026. K-12 students begin classes on August 18, 2025 and end on June 4, 2026, while preschool students begin August 19, 2025 and end June 3, 2026. Winter Vacation runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026, and Spring Vacation runs March 23-27, 2026. Parent-teacher conference days are October 27, 2025 and March 18, 2026 and are non-attendance days for students. CPS lists June 9-12 and June 15 as emergency days if student days fall below the state requirement.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CPS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Chicago Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 K-12 school year on Monday, August 18, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Winter Vacation in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Vacation runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Spring Vacation in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Vacation runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, March 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for K-12 students is Thursday, June 4, 2026.
